name: credit-repair-1.0.0
description: Generate FCRA-compliant credit dispute letters for sending via the Lob skill

tools.name: credit_repair
tools.description: Credit dispute letter generator and FCRA rights reference. Actions: 'generate_letter' (create HTML dispute letter ready for lob skill), 'get_bureau_address' (official bureau mailing address), 'list_dispute_reasons' (valid FCRA dispute grounds), 'fcra_rights' (consumer rights reference and timelines). Letter types: general_dispute, method_of_verification, debt_validation. Bureaus: experian, equifax, transunion, transunion_disputes. Generated HTML is sent via the lob skill's send_letter action.

action.description: What to do: generate_letter, get_bureau_address, list_dispute_reasons, fcra_rights

letter_type.description: Type of letter: general_dispute, method_of_verification, debt_validation

bureau.description: Credit bureau: experian, equifax, transunion, transunion_disputes

ssn_last4.description: Last 4 digits of SSN only (never full SSN)

creditor_name.description: Name of the creditor being disputed

explanation.description: Detailed explanation of why info is inaccurate (for general_dispute)

enclosures.description: List of supporting documents enclosed (for general_dispute)

original_dispute_date.description: Date of the original dispute response (for method_of_verification)
